About MMSAYAYA EDUVERSE

An online educational platform that brings different fields of knowledge together in one learning environment.

MMSAYAYA EDUVERSE provides access to learning resources, practice questions, online assessments and structured courses across technology, mathematics, Islamic studies and more.

Our Mission

To make quality multi-disciplinary education accessible, structured and practical for every learner.

Our Vision

To become a leading online learning platform that empowers students to learn today and lead tomorrow.

Our Objectives

Provide structured courses, free practice questions, online examinations, progress tracking and certificates across multiple fields of knowledge.

Structured Learning

Well-organized courses with clear outlines, lessons, and learning outcomes.

Free Practice Questions

Test your knowledge for free before enrolling in full courses.

Online Examinations

Timed exams with automatic scoring and detailed results.

Progress Tracking

Monitor your learning progress and earn certificates upon completion.

Katsina State School Registration

How it works

1.Submit school details below
2.Platform Admin reviews & verifies
3.Choose a subscription plan & pay
4.Receive Headmaster/Principal login

All 34 LGAs of Katsina State are supported. No school is created until Admin approves your request.

Backend Setup (Super Admin)

Cloud Functions and Security Rules must run on Firebase's servers, not in the browser. This page holds their complete code so this one HTML file contains everything. Copy each block to the place shown.

  1. Firebase Console > Authentication > Sign-in method: enable Email/Password and Google; add your website domain under Settings > Authorized domains.
  2. Spark plan: do NOT upgrade. Cloud Functions need Blaze, so the functions files below are an optional, future reference and are not used. Accounts are created immediately through a one-use internal role/school link; no invitation email is sent. Every permission is enforced by Firestore rules.
  3. Skip the functions deployment on Spark. Do not run firebase deploy --only functions.
  4. Paste the two rules into the Console and Publish (or run firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,storage, which works on Spark). Publish the new Firestore rules before anyone uses the invitation login.
  5. Admin-created accounts receive a rule-validated verificationBypass = true profile flag and can sign in without email verification. Do not set this flag for arbitrary users.

functions/index.js (optional - needs Blaze, not used on Spark)

Create a folder named functions in your Firebase project and save this as functions/index.js.


              

              

                

                  
functions/package.json

                  
                

                
Save this as functions/package.json (same folder), then run: cd functions && npm install

                

              

              

                

                  
firestore.rules

                  
                

                
Firebase Console > Firestore Database > Rules > paste > Publish.

                

              

              

                

                  
storage.rules

                  
                

                
Firebase Console > Storage > Rules > paste > Publish.

Classes Management

              
            

            

              

                Super Admin can apply the official class structure to all Primary or Secondary schools. Existing classes are kept; missing ones are added.
              

              

                
                
                
                
              

              

              

                Official class structure
                

                  

                    PRIMARY
                    
    
                      
  • Nursery 1, Nursery 2, Nursery 3
    • 
                      
  • Primary 1, Primary 2, Primary 3, Primary 4, Primary 5, Primary 6
    • 
                    

                  

                  

                    SECONDARY
                    
    
                      
  • JSS 1, JSS 2, JSS 3
    • 
                      
  • SS 1, SS 2, SS 3
    • 
                    

                  

                

              

              

                
                
              

              
Primary: Nursery 1–3 + Primary 1–6. Secondary: JSS 1–3 + SS 1–3.
